title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on John 15: the true vine and the branches, laying down one's life for friends, and the hatred of the world.

questions.text: What does Jesus call himself and his Father at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: He says, "I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer."

answers.text: The shepherd, and his Father the gatekeeper
The door, and his Father the fold
The branch, and his Father the vine
The true vine, and his Father the farmer

questions.text: What does the farmer do with a branch that bears fruit?
questions.explanation: Every branch that bears fruit he prunes, so that it may bear more fruit.

answers.text: He takes it away
He throws it into the fire
He prunes it to bear more fruit
He leaves it untouched

questions.text: What does Jesus say they can do apart from him?
questions.explanation: He says that he is the vine and they are the branches, and that apart from him they can do nothing.

answers.text: A little, but not much
Nothing
Bear fruit by themselves
Whatever they ask for

questions.text: What happens to someone who does not remain in him?
questions.explanation: He is thrown out as a branch and is withered, and such branches are gathered, thrown into the fire and burned.

answers.text: He is thrown out, withers and is burned
He is pruned to bear more fruit
He is made a servant
He is grafted into another vine

questions.text: Why has Jesus spoken these things to them?
questions.explanation: He says he has spoken them so that his joy may remain in them and their joy may be made full.

answers.text: So that they would be afraid
So that the world may believe
So that their joy may be made full
So that they would keep the law

questions.text: What does Jesus call the greatest love?
questions.explanation: He says that no one has greater love than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

answers.text: To keep all of his commandments
To bear much fruit for the farmer
To remain in the vine always
To lay down one's life for one's friends

questions.text: What does Jesus say he no longer calls them?
questions.explanation: He says he no longer calls them servants, because a servant does not know what his lord does, but he has called them friends.

answers.text: Servants
Friends
Branches
Disciples

questions.text: Who chose whom, according to Jesus?
questions.explanation: He says that they did not choose him, but that he chose them and appointed them to go and bear fruit.

answers.text: They chose him
He chose and appointed them
The Father chose the world
The world chose them

questions.text: Why does the world hate them, according to Jesus?
questions.explanation: He says that because they are not of the world, since he chose them out of the world, the world hates them.

answers.text: Because they bear no fruit
Because they keep the law of Moses
Because they do not know the Father
Because they are not of the world

questions.text: Why will the disciples also testify about him?
questions.explanation: He says that they will also testify, because they have been with him from the beginning.

answers.text: Because the world will listen to them
Because they have been with him from the beginning
Because they chose him first
Because they have seen the Father
